curated.instructions: omr/instructions/8832-1/ (scans; the roadster is pages 1-4, steps 1-13; pages 5-7 are the alternate model and pages 7-8 add the 8700 motor)

functions.does: The steering wheel steers the front wheels: an 8-tooth gear at the foot of the slanted steering column slides the steering rack across, and the rack's ends swing the two steering arms.
functions.source: book: steps 3-5 (steering arms), 8 (rack), 9-10 (column, gear and steering wheel)

functions.does: The rear wheels ride on a swinging arm: two 1x6 bricks pivot on the long axle under the seat and are joined at the back by an axle that pushes the shock absorber up against the roll bar, so the back wheels can rise and fall together.
functions.source: book: steps 11-13, the step 13 inset shows the shock absorber behind the seat
functions.note: how far the arm can swing depends on the shock absorber's travel; inferred: whether the shock's top is held on the roll bar's top axle or on the seat isn't clear in the scan

functions.does: The shock absorber's spring pushes the rear wheels back down.
functions.skip: a spring only matters under gravity or force

functions.does: The four wheels roll freely, each on its own axle pin; there's no drive.

questions.question: Does the shock's top attach to the roll bar's top axle?
